page: Amazon Web Services t9g.nano is an entry-level burstable instance powered by AWS Graviton arm64 processors operating at 3.3 GHz. Managed under the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance supplies 2 vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core. Memory capacity is configured at 0.5 GB, yielding an allocation of 0.25 GB of RAM per core.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is listed at 0 Gbps, reflecting an entry-tier networking profile with burst potential managed by the hypervisor. There are no attached graphics processing units and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. Operating on a burstable CPU model, the instance relies on CPU credit accumulation during idle periods to sustain short bursts of compute activity.

Given the severe memory constraint of 512 MB alongside burstable arm64 processing, the t9g.nano offers low resource footprint deployment economics for minimal background utilities. It serves well for lightweight monitoring daemons, simple automation scripts, micro-proxies, and basic development testing where application memory consumption remains strictly constrained.
